title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The UK government has developed a policy in response to a 2020 report on Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards. This policy aims to address the potential risks and opportunities of AI in the UK's public systems, setting standards for its development and use.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education is creating guidelines for the use of generative artificial intelligence in schools. The goal is to ensure the safe and effective integration of generative AI in educational settings.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual, the UK qualification regulator, outlines its approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector. This policy aims to ensure the integrity and validity of qualifications in the context of emerging AI technologies.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document assesses the impact of using copyrighted materials in the creation of artificial intelligence systems, exploring its effects on copyright laws and AI development. The report likely examines the intersection of intellectual property rights and emerging AI technologies.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to a House of Lords report outlining concerns about artificial intelligence in the country. The government's response addresses these concerns and outlines its plans for regulating AI in the UK.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference for a review of artificial intelligence and its impact on public standards. The review will be guided by a set of questions and considerations.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Cabinet Office's (CSPL) submission outlines their views on the governance of artificial intelligence. It was submitted to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry in order to inform their investigation.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This document likely discusses the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on the regulation of medical products, focusing on how AI is changing the way medical products are developed and reviewed. It aims to implement the principles set out in the AI White Paper to ensure the safe and effective use of AI in the medical product regulation process.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation a global leader in AI, becoming the most effective, efficient, trusted, and influential in its field for an organisation of its size. This vision seeks to achieve excellence in AI capabilities to support Defence operations and goals.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This document outlines a plan for the UK Department for Transport (DfT) to safely develop and integrate artificial intelligence (AI) in the transport sector. It aims to balance the benefits of AI with its potential risks.
